source_form_note: PDF page 5 explicitly describes the booklet as a compilation of speeches by M. Karunanidhi delivered at the Tiruvarur municipal high school and other places, compiled by தோழர் மு. நமச்சிவாயம். It is archived as one source unit without inferring a single original speech event.

speech.source_note: The source describes multiple speeches rather than a single event. It names திருவாரூர் நகராண்மைக் கழக உயர்நிலைப்பள்ளி and also says வேறு சில இடங்களிலும், but gives no component-speech dates or a single venue/event/occasion/audience. These single-event fields therefore remain null.

workflow.tamil_transcription_storage_note: PDF 6-45 is in transcription-ta.md; PDF 46-81 is preserved in t1-batches/batch-09 through batch-12. Confirmed T2 corrections are stored in t2-batches and are mandatory inputs to T3 canonical consolidation.
workflow.traditional_tamil_glyph_note: User review exposed systematic misreading of traditional pre-1978 glyph shapes as different modern Unicode syllables. Affected earlier T2 records were corrected, and Batches 8-10 (PDF 41-55) were audited with the corrected rule from the outset. Remaining T2 must map traditional glyphs such as னா/றா/ணா/னை/லை to their underlying Tamil character sequences rather than visual lookalikes.
